chatgpt.excluded_reasons: Approximate. Vendor/reseller promos (Blyth AI, Atlas Cloud, Higgsfield, Deevid, Ima Studio, PixVerse, happycapy, ComfyUI, @ChatGPT itself), a Retro Diffusion founder (@RealAstropulse) calling GPT image bad at pixel art (competitor vendor), news about Epic's art team (not own use), possible OpenAI-staff showcase, posts about coding not image gen, and unrelated chatter.

caveats: PARTIAL RUN: only midjourney and chatgpt were sampled. After 5 searches, X search began returning "Something went wrong. Try reloading." for every query (including a plain 'suno soundtrack game' test) and still failed after ~90 seconds of waiting, which looks like a search rate limit; per instructions the run stopped there. leonardo-ai and all later tools have no data (two Leonardo queries returned zero results because of the same error, not because there are no posts). Samples are small and non-random (X Top and Latest tabs, a few dozen results scanned per query, filtered by hand). Sentiment is about the named tool for the named job only. excluded_count values are approximate counts of unique scanned results not kept. X search surfaces AI-art/AI-video creator and prompt-sharing accounts far more than working game devs. Notes are paraphrases, not quotes.
